Task: Ratify the twelve-clause constitution and wire it into the stage template
Exit_criterion: Every stage prompt carries the clauses automatically. A contradicting prompt fails validation

Task: Open and amend the decision ledger
Exit_criterion: Conventional decisions have values and full amendment chains

Task: Publish the eight-threat taxonomy and rewrite every stop condition as a predicate
Exit_criterion: Zero name-based stop conditions survive validation

Task: Stand up execution-time provenance hashing in the runner
Exit_criterion: A deliberately mutated prompt blocks the run automatically

Task: Fetch and checksum every asset. PEACE repo and checkpoint, Predector container, PHI-base, MycoCosm
Exit_criterion: Every asset present with a recorded checksum and licence status

Task: Repair panel-level scoring, chance precision, cross-fitted headroom and split fields
Exit_criterion: Four regression tests fail against the prior behavior and both programs run on test data

Task: Axis enumeration in one pass across all five axes
Exit_criterion: One table, five counts, and a refusal to release any single count alone

Task: Build the union positive set from PHI-base, PEACE curated CSVs and Predector confirmed set
Exit_criterion: Deduplicated FASTA with per-sequence provenance and evidence code

Task: STRUCTURAL CLUSTERING. Predicted models for the union set, Foldseek all versus all, cluster at TM 0.50
Exit_criterion: Independent unit count at TM 0.50 reported together with sequence counts at 30, 40 and 50 percent

Task: Label eligibility filter. Retain functional evidence only
Exit_criterion: Every retained positive names an assay. Computational codes removed and counted

Task: Contamination audit. Publication and deposition date per positive against every subject cutoff
Exit_criterion: Pre-cutoff and post-cutoff strata sized and dated

Task: Tool coverage count. In planta RNA-seq, repeat annotation, assembly quality per species
Exit_criterion: Per-channel coverage fraction across the candidate cohort

Task: Units at or above 45 after structural clustering, functional labels, four channels covering most of cohort
Exit_criterion: Pass, or restate delta at 0.10, or close the task

Task: Build and freeze the design split that never gets scored
Exit_criterion: Split hashed and recorded before any floor runs

Task: Run Floor C, Predector, blinded, on design-split panels
Exit_criterion: Ranked output per panel, arm identity withheld from the Referee
Cost: 13 CPU hours per full cohort pass

Task: Run Floor M, PEACE, on the same panels with the checkpoint verified
Exit_criterion: Ranked output plus a served parameter count matching the card

Task: Build Floor M plus six channels and measure C by mechanical ablation
Exit_criterion: The channel count at which the fixed ensemble stops improving

Task: Compute sigma_d, N_min and MDE(N) for both cohort geometries
Exit_criterion: All three written to the ledger before any agent call exists

Task: THE HEADROOM TEST. Global channel weights against per-lifestyle oracle weights
Exit_criterion: H reported with an interval

Task: Item-design search over budget, channel set and contract shape, optimised for floor separation
Exit_criterion: Chosen design plus a search log showing the scored cohort was never touched

Task: H exceeds delta and the six-channel floor does not take the ceiling
Exit_criterion: Pass, or close the task with zero agent calls spent

Task: Generate roughly eighteen tool cards. Read the code first, then the defining paper
Exit_criterion: Every card carries a disagreement list, explicitly empty or non-empty

Task: Clear licences and rule on substitutions for SignalP, TMHMM and Phobius
Exit_criterion: Each substitution justified against precision at twenty with the recall spread quoted

Task: Construct validity check before functional certification for every tool
Exit_criterion: Each tool states the quantity it returns and its relation to the scored quantity

Task: Curate the effector fold library for the structural channel
Exit_criterion: Named folds, source structures, and a written statement that pLDDT is a covariate

Task: Containerise four arms in Harbor on Predector Nextflow and conda packaging
Exit_criterion: One command runs a cell end to end on either site

Task: Generate must-fire and must-not-fire controls for every gate, inheriting seeds S1 to S5
Exit_criterion: No gate arms until both of its controls have run

Task: Verify grants for all four arms from traces and model-side calls, including memory disablement
Exit_criterion: Arm 3 records a foundation-model firewall refusal; arm 4 returns a parseable score from the card-matching checkpoint; arms 1 and 2 satisfy their negative controls

Task: HARNESS CONTROL. One panel, one known-good model, full tool surface
Exit_criterion: Contract-compliant submission with per-candidate evidence

Task: Rule on prompt symmetry against prompt neutrality and record it
Exit_criterion: A written ruling naming the fabrication risk that file paths create for arm 1

Task: Measure tokens, wall time and coverage per cell. Set S and the repair budget from the curve
Exit_criterion: S and repair budget written to the ledger, sized against the actual token allocation

Task: Harness control passes and cost per cell fits the allocation at the chosen S
Exit_criterion: Pass, or loop back to tier 3, never to the subject model

Task: Freeze the preregistration and close the ledger for the run
Exit_criterion: Hash recorded. Later amendments append rather than overwrite

Task: Build the scored panels with disjoint structural clusters and same-organism decoys
Exit_criterion: Panel manifest with cluster IDs and an automated check that no cluster repeats. Every panel is stratified by whether its planted positive satisfies the canonical small, secreted, cysteine-rich profile, and the stratum is recorded in the panel manifest. The construction rule must exist before the panels do.

Task: Build saprotroph-decoy control panels to estimate the unknown-positive background rate
Exit_criterion: A background estimate that qualifies every absolute precision figure

Task: Run four arms at the frozen S with an identical repair budget
Exit_criterion: Coverage reported as a curve in S per arm. No arm scored zero for a wiring reason

Task: Score process metrics beside outcome against a forced-depth control at matched compute
Exit_criterion: Depth, explicit rejection and disagreement handling, each with its own denominator

Task: Report precision at twenty against chance, against Floor M plus, and with MDE at realised N
Exit_criterion: No effect appears without its MDE. The agent-against-floor difference is reported separately on the canonical and non-canonical strata, never pooled without a statement. Labelled positives over-represent canonical effectors while the plausible agent edge lies on the non-canonical ones, so a pooled number is a lower bound.

Task: Every arm measured, or explicitly declared unmeasured with a reason
Exit_criterion: Pass, or fix the wiring and rescore before any claim leaves the project

Task: Live cohort agent. Scheduled ingest of new validated effectors under frozen rules
Exit_criterion: First refresh produces a dated vintage. No pooling across vintages without a statement

Task: Convene the asymmetric verifier panel at every gate
Exit_criterion: Disagreement aggregated, not opinion. Verifiers sharing a source counted once

Task: Maintain the failure ledger. Classify every failure into one of the five classes
Exit_criterion: Each new failure either matches a class or forces a constitution amendment
